notes: Voice recognition fix: an earlier change wrongly preferred offline recognition, which this phone's Google service cannot serve for these languages (every attempt failed). Recognition now uses the service's normal online routing, like Google's own voice typing. Speech-language errors, if any, now show a plain message naming the language instead of an error code, and stop the session immediately instead of retrying. Everything else is unchanged from v0.9.2 (character avatars, AI, Diagnostics).
